title: 47 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Emergency & Health)
description:
Learn 47 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 47 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

EMERGENCY & HEALTH · 紧急情况与健康
• I think I'm having an allergic reaction - 我觉得我可能过敏了，  [wo juede wo ke neng GUO MIN le,]
• My lips are swelling, I need help - 我的嘴唇在肿，快帮帮我，  [wo de zui chun zai zhong, kuai bang bang wo,]
• I swallowed something and it's stuck - 我吞下去了，但卡住了，  [wo tun xia qu le, dan ka zhu le,]
• I can't stop vomiting, please advise - 我一直在吐，能不能告诉我怎么办，  [wo yi zhi zai tu, neng bu neng gao su wo zen me ban,]
• Severe stomach pain, I feel worse - 我肚子疼得很厉害，越来越难受，  [wo du zi teng de hen li hai, yue lai yue nan shou,]
• I just cut myself, it won't stop - 我刚割伤了，止不住血，  [wo gang ge shang le, zhi bu zhu xue,]

GRATITUDE · 感恩
• Thank you for hearing me today. - 谢谢你今天听见我。  [Xièxie nǐ jīntiān tīngjiàn wǒ.]
• I appreciate your steady reassurance. - 我感谢你给的踏实安慰。  [Wǒ gǎnxiè nǐ gěi de tàshí ānwèi.]
• Your kindness changed my mood. - 你的善意改变了我的心情。  [Nǐ de shànyì gǎibiàn le wǒ de xīnqíng.]
• I’m grateful for your follow-through. - 我感恩你说到做到。  [Wǒ gǎn'ēn nǐ shuōdào zuòdào.]
• Thanks for the honest check-in. - 谢谢你来认真关心我。  [Xièxie nǐ lái rènzhēn guānxīn wǒ.]
• Your help made things lighter. - 你的帮助让我轻松了很多。  [Nǐ de bāngzhù ràng wǒ qīngsōng le hěn duō.]

BALANCE · 平衡
• I choose calm on purpose, not out of fear. - 我有意选择平静，不是因为害怕。  [Wo yǒu yì xuǎnzé píngjìng, bù shì yīnwèi hàipà.]
• I pause, then pick the kindest next step. - 我先停一停，再选最温柔的下一步。  [Wo xiān tíng yí tíng, zài xuǎn zuì wēnróu de xià yí bù.]
• Balance means giving myself rest, guilt-free. - 平衡就是让自己休息，问心无愧。  [Pínghéng jiùshì ràng zìjǐ xiūxi, wènxīn wúkuì.]
• I keep plans realistic, and my body heard. - 我把计划做得更现实，也把身体放在心上。  [Wo bǎ jìhuà zuò de gèng xiànshí, yě bǎ shēntǐ fàng zài xīnxìng shàng.]
• Too much today, so I scale down. - 今天太多了，我就把节奏降下来。  [Jīntiān tài duō le, wo jiù bǎ jiézòu jiàng xiàlái.]

SHOPPING & PRICES · 购物与价格
• I need the total, not the tag - 我要看总价，不是看标价。  [wǒ yào kàn zǒngjià, bú shì kàn biāojià.]
• Any hidden fees before I pay? - 付款前会不会有隐形费用？  [fùkuǎn qián huì bú huì yǒu yǐnxíng fèiyòng?]
• Show me the best size value - 给我看看最划算的尺码。  [gěi wǒ kàn kàn zuì huásuàn de chǐmǎ.]
• Does it include tax and shipping? - 价格里包含税和运费吗？  [jiàgé lǐ bāohán shuì hé yùnfèi ma?]
• I’ll ask for a price match - 我可以要价保吗？  [wǒ kěyǐ yào jiàbǎo ma?]
• Can I see it in the light? - 能给我在灯下看看实物吗？  [néng gěi wǒ zài dēng xià kàn kàn shíwù ma?]

HAPPINESS · 幸福
• I check in, then I reset. - 我先确认自己，再把节奏调回去。  [Wo xian queren zi ji, zai ba jie zou diao hui qu.]
• Joy can be quiet, still real. - 快乐可以很安静，但依然真实。  [Kuai le ke yi hen an jing, dan yi ran zhen shi.]
• I let my breath choose my calm. - 我让呼吸带我回到平静。  [Wo rang hu xi dai wo hui dao ping jing.]
• I do one tiny thing right now. - 我现在就做一件小事，做对就好。  [Wo xian zai jiu zuo yi jian xiao shi, zuo dui jiu hao.]
• I make space for rest today. - 我给休息留出位置，今天也可以。  [Wo gei xiu xi liu chu wei zhi, jin tian ye ke yi.]
• My happiness starts with what I notice. - 幸福从我愿意看见的东西开始。  [Xing fu cong wo yuan yi kan jian de dong xi kai shi.]

MEETING PEOPLE & GREETINGS · 认识新朋友与问候
• Hi, I’m happy to meet you. - 你好，很高兴认识你。  [Nǐ hǎo, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.]
• What’s your name, may I ask? - 你叫什么名字呀，我可以问吗？  [Nǐ jiào shénme míngzì ya, wǒ kěyǐ wèn ma?]
• I’m glad we can talk today. - 我很高兴今天能聊聊。  [Wǒ hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng liáo liáo.]
• Where are you from originally? - 你最开始是从哪里来的？  [Nǐ zuì kāishǐ shì cóng nǎlǐ lái de?]
• How do you like this place? - 你觉得这里怎么样？  [Nǐ juéde zhè lǐ zěnmeyàng?]
• Do you have time for a chat? - 你现在方便聊一会儿吗？  [Nǐ xiànzài fāngbiàn liáo yíhuìr ma?]

FRIENDSHIP · 友谊
• Your friendship steadies me. - 你 的 友谊 让我 稳下来。  [nǐ de yǒuyì ràng wǒ wěn xiàlái]
• We celebrate your wins together. - 你 的 胜利 我们 一起 庆祝。  [nǐ de shènglì wǒmen yìqǐ qìngzhù]
• I trust you, always. - 我 信任 你，永远。  [wǒ xìnrèn nǐ, yǒngyuǎn]
• Thanks for choosing me again. - 谢谢 你 又 一次 选择 我。  [xièxie nǐ yòu yí cì xuǎnzé wǒ]
• I show up, no big speech. - 我 会 出现，不用 说 很多。  [wǒ huì chūxiàn, búyòng shuō hěn duō]
• You get me without explanation. - 你 懂 我，不用 解释。  [nǐ dǒng wǒ, búyòng jiěshì]

FORGIVENESS · 宽恕
• I forgive, and I move forward. - 我宽恕了，然后继续往前走。  [Wǒ kuānshù le, ránhòu jìxù wǎng qián zǒu.]
• No excuses, just repair. - 不找借口，只做修复。  [Bù zhǎo jièkǒu, zhǐ zuò xiūfù.]
